metadata.study: Phase 22 H1 — Measurement Architecture Decision Study

M0.name: Canonical Scalar Surprise
M0.semantic_role: Canonical physiological prediction-error intensity and somatic urgency gating.
M0.known_limitation: Isotropic norm collapses materially different PAD displacement trajectories into identical scalar values.

M1.name: Scalar + Ternary Directional Sign (R3)
M1.dof_breakdown: 1 continuous magnitude float + 27 discrete sign states (optimal encoding ceil(log2(27)) = 5 bits, distinct from '3 bits')
M1.semantic_role: Preserves scalar surprise magnitude alongside coarse discrete PAD octant/quadrant orientation.
M1.known_limitation: Discretizes continuous angular nuance; non-zero collapses persist at short exposures T < 12.

M2.name: Scalar + Continuous Unit Direction (R2)
M2.dof_breakdown: 3 independent mathematical degrees of freedom: 1 magnitude + 2 directional angles on S^2
M2.semantic_role: Preserves exact scalar surprise magnitude alongside continuous high-precision trigonometric orientation.
M2.known_limitation: Requires 4 stored floats; added continuous precision provided 0 incremental behavioral divergence in tested same-sign regime.

M3.name: Full Vector Residual (Cartesian Coordinates)
M3.dof_breakdown: 3 independent mathematical degrees of freedom (r_P, r_A, r_D)
M3.semantic_role: Joint representation of prediction residual across all three emotional dimensions.
M3.known_limitation: Dominance component demonstrably dispensable for collapse resolution under frozen G1 regime; full 3D representation is sufficient but not minimal.

M4.name: Prediction-Residual Vector (Online Adapted)
M4.dof_breakdown: 3 independent mathematical degrees of freedom representing generative expectation error
M4.semantic_role: Explicit Active Inference prediction error capturing violations of internal generative model forecasts.

semantic_distinctions.resting_state_displacement: Delta_p = p_T - p_philia (raw bodily excursion from resting attractor)
semantic_distinctions.prediction_residual: r_T = p_hat_T - p_T (divergence between internal generative expectation and bodily sensory feedback)
semantic_distinctions.scalar_norm: S = ||r_T||_2 (scalar Euclidean magnitude of prediction residual)

M5.name: Precision-Weighted Scalar Candidates
element_types: float (continuous scalar derived from quadratic form)
M5.dof_breakdown: 1 scalar magnitude weighted by predefined matrix Pi in {Pi_0, Pi_1, Pi_2, Pi_3}
M5.semantic_role: Exploratory precision weighting candidate testing anisotropic sensory confidence.
M5.known_limitation: Candidates Pi_1 (somatic urgency) and Pi_2 (geometric normalization) failed to satisfy preregistered Gate 2 thresholds under conversational exposure; remain unvalidated exploratory hypotheses.

M0_Canonical_Scalar.information_retained: Scalar surprise magnitude, somatic intensity, urgency gating, monotonic association with cognitive load (r >= 0.888) and tension (r >= 0.806).
M0_Canonical_Scalar.information_discarded: Angular orientation, PAD octant sign, component-specific attribution (Pleasure vs Arousal vs Dominance).
M0_Canonical_Scalar.collapse_resolution: FAILS: 358 Medium-High collapse pairs (|Delta S| <= 0.02) at T=12, with mean angular separation 86.0 deg and opposing Pleasure polarity.
M0_Canonical_Scalar.behavioral_utilization: 0/358 collapse pairs differentiated (0.00%) in research adapter.
M0_Canonical_Scalar.computational_cost: 1 continuous float (minimal storage and zero vector processing overhead).
M0_Canonical_Scalar.semantic_compatibility: Fully compatible with canonical scalar Active Inference surprise magnitude.

M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.information_retained: Scalar surprise magnitude S + coarse octant sign orientation in {-1, 0, +1}^3.
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.information_discarded: Within-quadrant continuous angular nuance, continuous component ratios.
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.collapse_resolution: SUPPORTED AT T>=12: 0 collapses under conversational exposures (T in {12, 16, 25}); retains collapses at short exposures T < 12 (968 at T=1, 682 at T=2, 66 at T=4/8).
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.behavioral_utilization: SUPPORTED AT T=12: Differentiates 286/358 (79.89%) collapse pairs, reproducing 100% of the discrete action distinctions observed under continuous direction R2.
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.computational_cost: 1 float + 3 ternary symbols (27 discrete states, optimal encoding 5 bits).
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.semantic_compatibility: Preserves canonical scalar surprise S bit-exact while appending a decoupled directional side-channel.

M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.information_retained: Scalar surprise magnitude S + continuous unit direction on S^2 (exact orientation).
M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.information_discarded: Independent component scale beyond unit norm (preserved jointly with S).
M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.collapse_resolution: SUPPORTED ACROSS ALL T: 0 collapses across all evaluated exposure ticks T in [1, 25].
M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.behavioral_utilization: Differentiates 286/358 (79.89%) collapse pairs at T=12. Under the predefined same-sign matched-pair subset, no eligible pair exhibited >= 30 deg angular divergence; therefore no incremental behavioral divergence was observed in this test (D_pol = 0.0000).
M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.computational_cost: 4 continuous floats (1 scalar + 3-component unit vector; requires normalization check).
M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.semantic_compatibility: Preserves canonical scalar surprise S bit-exact while appending a continuous trigonometric orientation side-channel.

M3_Full_Vector_Residual.information_retained: Full 3D Cartesian coordinates, joint magnitude and direction.
M3_Full_Vector_Residual.information_discarded: None within 3D PAD linear prediction residual space.
M3_Full_Vector_Residual.collapse_resolution: SUPPORTED: 0 collapses across all exposures T in [1, 25].
M3_Full_Vector_Residual.behavioral_utilization: Behaviorally sufficient, but Dominance component shown to be dispensable under frozen G1 regime (A3 ablation achieves 0 collapses).
M3_Full_Vector_Residual.computational_cost: 3 continuous floats (requires multi-dimensional downstream policy arbitration).
M3_Full_Vector_Residual.semantic_compatibility: Directly represents 3D prediction residual vector; departs from canonical 1D scalar surprise pipeline.

M4_Prediction_Residual_Vector.information_retained: Generative model expectation error, explicitly distinguishing internal expectation failure from raw bodily displacement.
M4_Prediction_Residual_Vector.information_discarded: None from internal expectation failure perspective.
M4_Prediction_Residual_Vector.collapse_resolution: SUPPORTED: Diverges from bodily displacement Delta_p by 179.5 deg at T=12 under online adaptation.
M4_Prediction_Residual_Vector.behavioral_utilization: Captures true cognitive expectation error rather than reflexive bodily trajectory.
M4_Prediction_Residual_Vector.computational_cost: 3 continuous floats + online expectation adaptation state.
M4_Prediction_Residual_Vector.semantic_compatibility: Gold-standard semantic Active Inference prediction error formulation.

M5_Precision_Weighted_Candidates.information_retained: Scalar quadratic form weighted by fixed exploratory precision matrix Pi.
M5_Precision_Weighted_Candidates.information_discarded: Directional sign, orthogonal subspace components ablated by weighting.
M5_Precision_Weighted_Candidates.collapse_resolution: REJECTED UNDER SPECIFIC REGIME: Fixed precision candidates Pi_1 (diag(1,4,1)) and Pi_2 (geometric bounds) failed to resolve Gate 2 compression at conversational exposures.
M5_Precision_Weighted_Candidates.behavioral_utilization: NOT TESTED in downstream behavioral adapter (eliminated at measurement stage).
M5_Precision_Weighted_Candidates.computational_cost: 1 continuous float (3x3 matrix multiplication during measurement).
M5_Precision_Weighted_Candidates.semantic_compatibility: Theoretically grounded in precision-weighted prediction error, but specific evaluated weights unvalidated.

what_scalar_m0_can_explain: Physiological intensity and emotional arousal activation magnitude.
Urgency gating: monotonic driver of cognitive load (r >= 0.888) and somatic tension (r >= 0.806).
Reasoning depth tier switching (k in {0, 1, 2}) driven by overall prediction-error shock (r = 0.8646).
Homogeneous scalar surprise without regard to emotional polarity.
what_scalar_m0_cannot_explain: Cannot differentiate orthogonal emotional trajectories sharing similar Euclidean norm (e.g. 358 collapse pairs at T=12).
Cannot distinguish positive hedonic valence (+0.19) from negative hedonic valence (-0.13) when magnitudes coincide.
Cannot provide directional orientation to guide qualitative communicative strategies (empathy vs direct execution).
Cannot achieve Gate 2 separation thresholds (Delta_HM >= 0.15) under current coupled ODE dynamics at conversational exposures.
rq2_scalar_sufficiency_boundary.preservation_status: Scalar surprise S remains an essential, empirically verified intensity and urgency driver; it is insufficient as a complete multi-dimensional measurement, but NOT useless or invalid.

scope_distinctions.geometric_collapse_resolution: R3 resolves 100% of Medium-High collapse pairs at conversational exposures T >= 12 (0 collapses at T in {12, 16, 25}).
scope_distinctions.short_exposure_limitation: R3 retains non-zero collapses at shorter exposure ticks (968 at T=1, 682 at T=2, 66 at T=4/8). Complete geometric resolution is NOT verified for T < 12.
scope_distinctions.behavioral_sufficiency: Within the evaluated 358 Medium-High collapse pairs at T=12, R3 reproduced 100% of the discrete action policy distinctions observed under continuous direction R2 (286/286 pairs, 79.89%).
scope_distinctions.global_minimality_status: NOT GLOBALLY MINIMAL: Other representations (e.g., A3 ablation [r_P, r_A] or [S, r_A]) also achieved 0 collapses under Candidate G1. R3 is potentially minimal only within the predefined discrete candidate set at T >= 12.
scope_distinctions.production_necessity_status: UNPROVEN: All behavioral findings are strictly scoped to the isolated research adapter. End-to-end SLM validation has not been performed.

unresolved_aspects: Behavioral utility at short conversational exposures (T in {1, 2, 4, 8}).
Behavioral utility in subtle same-sign sub-quadrant shifts.
End-to-end conditioning of local Small Language Model (Layer 6).
Long-term interaction history and synaptic homeostatic consolidation.

test_2a_within_quadrant_findings.criteria: Matched scalar magnitude (|S_i - S_j| <= 0.02) and identical ternary sign vector (sign(r_i) == sign(r_j)).
test_2a_within_quadrant_findings.empirical_verdict: Under the predefined same-sign matched-pair subset, no eligible pair exhibited >= 30 deg angular divergence; therefore no incremental behavioral divergence was observed in this test.

test_2b_sign_transition_findings.criteria: Matched scalar magnitude (|S_i - S_j| <= 0.02) across differing ternary sign vectors.
test_2b_sign_transition_findings.empirical_verdict: Discrete sign transitions account for 100% of the observed action differentiation across matched pairs.

rq4_r2_incremental_value.scope_limitation: Under the predefined same-sign matched-pair subset, no eligible pair exhibited >= 30 deg angular divergence; therefore no incremental behavioral divergence was observed in this test. With N=0 eligible pairs, p=1.0 reflects the absence of eligible test cases rather than inferential proof that R2 lacks value generally. This avoids a generalized conclusion that R2 has no incremental value in unconstrained, continuous expressive spaces.

rq5_measurement_semantics.semantic_chain: Generative Prediction -> Prediction Error -> Physiological Surprise

distinctions.scalar_surprise_magnitude: 1D Euclidean distance ||r_T||_2 representing raw intensity of prediction violation.
distinctions.vector_prediction_error: 3D directional vector r_T = p_hat_T - p_T representing dimension-specific expectation failure.
distinctions.directional_side_channel: Coarse (sign) or continuous (unit vector) orientation appended alongside scalar surprise to preserve intensity gating.
distinctions.derived_behavioral_features: Downstream policy arbitrations (cognitive load, tension, depth k, action a) derived from limbic state.

rq5_measurement_semantics.crucial_finding: A representation may be behaviorally useful (e.g. R3 sign side-channel) without being identical to the unified scalar surprise variable. Appending R3 as a decoupled side-channel preserves canonical scalar surprise semantics bit-exact.

rq6_gate2_reconciliation.what_gate_2_establishes: Canonical scalar surprise S = ||r_T||_2 under Protocol v1.4 cannot satisfy preregistered dual separation thresholds (Delta_ML >= 0.10, Delta_HM >= 0.15) at conversational exposure (T=12) due to basal semantic density floor and Coupled MT-LNN ODE saturation: S_M = 0.5792, S_H = 0.6477, yielding Delta_HM = +0.0685 < 0.15.
rq6_gate2_reconciliation.what_gate_2_does_not_establish: Gate 2 failure does NOT prove that semantic prediction error is impossible, nor does it invalidate directional information. Directional and component differences persist strongly under magnitude matching.
rq6_gate2_reconciliation.protocol_requirement: A future directional measurement architecture cannot retroactively declare Protocol v1.4 Gate 2 resolved. It requires a dedicated, newly ratified research protocol and evaluation harness.

M0_Scalar.interpretability: High for intensity; Zero for direction
M0_Scalar.policy_adapter_compatibility: Native intensity driver; blind to qualitative strategy

M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.representation_size: 1 float32 + 3 int8/symbols (5-7 bytes; optimal encoding 5 bits)
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.serialization_complexity: Very low (scalar float + 3 sign integers in {-1, 0, 1})
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.interpretability: Very high (explicit octant quadrant: positive/negative valence, arousal, dominance)
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.compatibility_with_s4: High (scalar S preserved bit-exact; sign passed as optional auxiliary tuple)
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.policy_adapter_compatibility: Direct discrete mapping to communicative strategies and qualitative framing
M1_Scalar_Ternary_Sign.fallback_compatibility: 100% bit-exact fallback by zeroing/neutralizing sign terms (C0 identical)

M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.compatibility_with_s4: Moderate (requires 4D vector schema or auxiliary vector field)
M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.policy_adapter_compatibility: Continuous modulation; but demonstrated 0 incremental value over signs
M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.fallback_compatibility: 100% bit-exact fallback by zeroing direction vector
M2_Scalar_Continuous_Direction.risk_of_unnecessary_info: Moderate (stores continuous orientation that downstream policy did not utilize)

M3_Full_Vector.interpretability: Moderate-High (raw component residuals r_P, r_A, r_D)
M3_Full_Vector.compatibility_with_s4: Breaking (replaces scalar surprise pipeline with 3D vector pipeline)
M3_Full_Vector.policy_adapter_compatibility: Requires re-architecting downstream gating from scalar to 3D manifold
M3_Full_Vector.fallback_compatibility: Poor (requires parallel dual pipeline or lossy scalarization)
M3_Full_Vector.risk_of_unnecessary_info: Moderate-High (Dominance component dispensable under frozen G1)

rq8_failure_modes.title: Short Exposure Incomplete Resolution
rq8_failure_modes.description: R3 exhibits non-zero collapses at short exposure ticks T in {1, 2, 4, 8} (up to 968 collapses at T=1). If future interactive dialogue operates primarily in sub-second regimes (T < 8 ticks / 800ms), R3 discrete signs may prove insufficient for collapse resolution.

rq8_failure_modes.title: Untested Continuous Value in Richer Action Regimes
rq8_failure_modes.description: R2 continuous unit direction provided zero incremental value in the 6-action discrete research adapter. A richer, continuous prosodic/blendshape generation space may reveal unobserved utility for high-precision trigonometric orientation.

rq8_failure_modes.title: Research Adapter vs. End-to-End SLM Divergence
rq8_failure_modes.description: All behavioral utilization findings are established in an isolated research adapter (EFE policy arbitration). A local Small Language Model (Layer 6) conditioned on directional prompts may interpret or ignore directional signals differently than the adapter.

rq8_failure_modes.title: Ternary Discretization Boundary Artifacts
rq8_failure_modes.description: Mapping continuous trajectories into {-1, 0, +1}^3 introduces threshold discretization boundaries near zero (|r_i| < epsilon). Small perturbations around zero could cause discrete sign jitter.

rq8_failure_modes.title: Adapter Prior Bias Favoring Discrete Signs
rq8_failure_modes.description: The research adapter's Expected Free Energy formulas use piecewise linear modulation terms that align naturally with discrete octant signs, potentially introducing an inductive bias favoring R3.

rq8_failure_modes.title: Homeostatic Synaptic Consolidation Interference
rq8_failure_modes.description: Long-term Tier 3 offline synaptic consolidation (BPTT) operates on continuous weight tensors. Introducing discrete side-channels into persistent relational memory traces has not been tested for dynamical stability.

rq8_failure_modes.title: Frozen Corpus G1 Specificity
rq8_failure_modes.description: All evidence is conditioned on the frozen Candidate G1 stimulus set (N=270, seed 9999). Broad distribution shifts or unconstrained open-domain human dialogue could alter component separation geometry.

rq9_decision_state.title: D1 — Scalar + R3 supported for future architectural consideration
rq9_decision_state.rationale: Under the predefined research-harness criteria and frozen G1 evaluation regime, canonical scalar S is retained as an intensity and urgency gating driver, while discrete ternary sign side-channel R3 is supported for future architectural consideration because it resolves collapse at conversational exposures (T >= 12) and reproduces all behavioral distinctions observed under continuous direction R2 on the evaluated collapse pairs, without incurring the unutilized continuous overhead of R2 or the breaking pipeline changes of full vector R5. D2 is not supported as necessary under the predefined Phase 22 behavioral criteria and evaluated research regime, and D3 is not supported as required/minimal under the evaluated criteria (Dominance dispensable under frozen G1).
rq9_decision_state.governance_lock: CRITICAL: State D1 MUST NOT be described as 'Architecture Approved'. Production Architecture Gate remains STRICTLY LOCKED.
